description.value: Hillcrest Bakery and Deli is a White Rock institution with over 40 years of history, owned by David and Sheana Moyer since 2011. David trained with a German bakery and the shop is known for hand-crafted breads, custom cakes, and deli items made entirely from scratch. Cyclists can pick up fresh baked goods, deli items, and prepared take-out dinners here.
